primary_derivative.proof: The lifted constant twist is a flat SO(3) connection along S1, so horizontal differentiation replaces k by k+alpha(A_hat dot J_ell). On the action-reduced p or q primary, the adjoint-cokernel pairing is the Feynman-Hellmann derivative. Both primaries are even in covariant momentum; at k=0 the derivative vanishes. Derivatives of any regular action Gram or basis factor multiply p or q and vanish on shell.
